login.offlineHint: Sign in becomes available as soon as the server answers.

home.title: Rooms
home.emptyHint: This account has no room configured on the server.

room.empty: This room has nothing to control.

audio.label: Audio
audio.title: Audio players
audio.emptyHint: This account has no audio player configured on the server.

camera.label: Camera
camera.title: Cameras
camera.emptyHint: This account has no camera configured on the server.

unlock.title: Admin password
unlock.hint: Updates and restarts are protected by the admin password. It is not the one you sign in with.
unlock.label: Admin password

bootstrap.title: Choose an admin password
bootstrap.hint: It protects updates and restarts, and is separate from your sign-in password. At least {min} characters.
bootstrap.allowedHostsHint: Once the admin password is set, the app is accepted under any name over https; without https, only from the box's IP address and from: {hosts}
bootstrap.allowedHostsNone: Once the admin password is set, the app is accepted under any name over https, but without https only from the box's IP address, unless you add names to api_allowed_hosts.
bootstrap.label: New admin password

household.title: Change your sign-in password first
household.hint: Your box still uses a default sign-in. Choose your own before setting an admin password.

change.title: Change the admin password
change.label: New admin password
change.hint: At least {min} characters. You will stay unlocked with the new password.
change.codeHint: A code will then be sent to your approver phone.

notice.unavailableHint: Administration from the app is only available on Calaos OS. Trying again automatically.
notice.activatingHint: The box is finishing its update. This usually takes a minute; trying again automatically.
notice.rebootBoxHint: Activation is taking too long. Unplug the box and plug it back in — or, over SSH: ssh root{'@'}<box address>, then reboot.
notice.unreachableHint: Trying again automatically. Your admin session is kept.
notice.oldServerHint: This box cannot be administered from the app yet. Update it once with its usual update (the button on the touch screen, or calaos-os upgrade); after that, updates run from here.
notice.httpsHint: Administration only works over a secure connection. Open the app again with an address that starts with https://.

updates.title: Updates
updates.unknownHint: Checking contacts the Calaos servers and can take up to a minute.
updates.upToDate: Your box is up to date
updates.availableHint: Installing takes a few minutes. The box stays usable; the app may lose the connection for a moment and comes back on its own.
updates.upgradingHint: Keep the box powered. The app may lose the connection for a moment while calaos-server restarts; it comes back on its own.
updates.externalRun: An update started from elsewhere is running.
updates.doneHint: Everything installed. The box is ready.
updates.doneRebootHint: Some of what was installed only takes effect after a restart.
updates.failedHint: Try again. If it fails again, the detail is in the box's logs.
updates.failedInterrupted: The update was interrupted before the end. Try again.

actions.title: Box
actions.passwordHint: Change the password that protects this page.
actions.rebootHint: Takes about a minute. Your lights and shutters keep their state.
actions.rebootConfirmHint: The app reconnects on its own once the box is back.
actions.mcpHint: The token AI assistants use to talk to the box. Regenerating it disconnects the ones already set up.
actions.mcpConfirmHint: Assistants using the current token lose access until they are set up again with the new one.
actions.passwordNeedsApprover: Add an approver phone first (section above). Without one, the admin password can only be changed over SSH with calaos-os admin set.

info.session_invalidated: The admin password was just changed. Enter the new one.
info.already_set: Someone just set the admin password. Enter it to continue.
info.mcp_regenerated: New MCP token generated. Read it from the Calaos installer.
info.reboot_sent: Restarting the box… the app reconnects on its own.
info.code_locked: Too many wrong codes. Enter the admin password again.

error.admin_not_set: No admin password is set yet.
error.admin_already_set: Someone just set the admin password.
error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds} s.
error.bad_session: Your admin session has ended. Enter the admin password again.
error.password_too_short: The password must have at least {min} characters.
error.https_required: Use https:// to administer the box.
error.daemon_too_old: Administration is being activated. Try again in a moment.
error.daemon_unreachable: The box is not answering. Try again in a moment.
error.admin_unavailable: Administration unavailable: calaos-container cannot be reached (only on Calaos OS).
error.upgrade_in_progress: An update is already in progress.
error.package_not_found: This package has no update waiting. {msg}
error.package_held: This package is held on the box and won't be updated.
error.approver_required: Add an approver phone first (the “Approver phones” section). Without one, the admin password can only be changed over SSH, with calaos-os admin set.
error.approver_exists: This phone is already an approver.
error.approver_not_found: This phone is no longer an approver. The list was just updated.
error.approver_last: Add another phone first: the last one cannot be removed.
error.code_required: A code is needed. Ask for a new one.
error.code_expired: This code has expired. Ask for a new one.
error.busy: Another operation is in progress. Try again in a moment.
error.internal: Something went wrong on the box. Try again; the detail is in the box's logs.
error.timeout: The box did not answer. calaos-server may be too old: update the box once with its usual update (the button on the touch screen, or calaos-os upgrade).
error.disconnected: Connection lost before the box answered. Try again once it is back.
error.household_refused: Your sign-in password could not be changed. Sign out and back in, then try again.

approvers.title: Approver phones
approvers.intro: A code sent to your phone confirms sensitive changes: the admin password and the approver phones.
approvers.noneHint: Add your phone to be able to change the admin password from the app. The Calaos app must be installed on it and connected to this box.
approvers.gone: No longer receives codes: open the Calaos app on this phone to reconnect it.
approvers.stale: Open the Calaos app on this phone soon: after 30 days without a connection, it stops receiving codes.
approvers.max: Two phones at most. Remove one to add another.
approvers.removeHint: This phone will no longer receive admin codes. A confirmation code will be sent.
approvers.loadFailed: The list of phones could not be read.

pick.title: Add a phone
pick.hint: These are the devices where the Calaos app is connected to this box. Several share the same name? Go by the date and the last activity.
pick.empty: No phone available. Install the Calaos app on your phone, connect it to this box and allow notifications, then try again.
pick.next: Send a code to this phone
pick.secondHint: Your current approver phone first gets a code to allow the new one.

last.title: The last phone cannot be removed
last.body: There must always be at least one approver phone. To switch phones, add the new one first, then remove the old one.
last.lost: Lost your phone? From a computer, connect to the box over SSH and run calaos-os admin reset, then choose a new admin password.

approve_enroll.title: Allow the new phone
approve_enroll.hint: Enter the code received on {phone}: it is the one that allows a new phone in.

confirm_enroll.title: Confirm the new phone
confirm_enroll.hint: A code was just sent to {phone}. Enter it to confirm you have the phone with you.

password.title: Confirm with your phone
password.hint: Enter the code received on {phone} to change the admin password.

code.label: 6-digit code
code.expired: This code has expired. Ask for a new one.
code.wrong: Wrong code. No attempts left. | Wrong code. {count} attempt left. | Wrong code. {count} attempts left.
code.resendIn: Send a new code in {seconds} s
code.notReceived: Nothing received? Check that notifications are allowed for the Calaos app on that phone.
code.restartHint: A new code means asking {phone} again.

alerts.hint: If this was not you, someone knows the admin password. From a computer, over SSH: calaos-os admin reset, then choose a new admin password.
alerts.more: And {count} other change. | And {count} other changes.
alerts.label: Security alert
